title: Declare execute-plans GitHub slug in orchestrator config
base_sha_note: base_sha is dev tip f15be762ef373cd24707b89e5b9b286650b9a097, the exact parent this task branch (task/OPS-EXECUTE-PLANS-REPO-SLUG-001) was opened from; the worker worktree HEAD matched this SHA before any task commit.

diagnosis.problem: coordination.repositories.execute_plans in the committed .orchestrator/config.json declares only local_path; unlike the pantheon entry (which declares repo explicitly) and unlike .orchestrator/config.example.json (which declares repo explicitly for both repositories), execute_plans' GitHub slug is left implicit.
diagnosis.reproduce_first: multi_repo_registry.repository_slug(config, 'execute_plans') already returned 'ajoe734/execute-plans' before this change, because DEFAULT_REPOSITORIES in .orchestrator/multi_repo_registry.py has carried repo='ajoe734/execute-plans' as a Python-side fallback since commit d69ba996f (2026-05-14, FE-INT-GATE-A10) and repositories() merges the committed override onto that default without erasing keys the override omits. Reading the raw committed dict entry directly (coordination.repositories.execute_plans.get('repo'), bypassing the registry merge) returns None -- this is the literal fact the task's dispatch evidence observed. Any code path that reads the raw config JSON instead of going through repository_slug()/resolve_repository(), or a future change to DEFAULT_REPOSITORIES, would silently lose this slug with no compile-time or config-level signal.
diagnosis.correction: Declare the slug explicitly in the committed config so the source of truth for execute_plans.repo lives in coordination policy (.orchestrator/config.json), matching the existing pantheon entry and .orchestrator/config.example.json, rather than solely in a Python module default. This removes the implicit dependency without changing repository_slug()'s resolution behavior, which already returned the correct slug.

owned: .orchestrator/config.json: added "repo": "ajoe734/execute-plans" to coordination.repositories.execute_plans, alongside the existing local_path.

.orchestrator/test_multi_repo_registry.py: added test_committed_config_declares_execute_plans_github_slug (loads the committed .orchestrator/config.json and asserts repository_slug resolves both ajoe734/pantheon and ajoe734/execute-plans) and test_repository_slug_is_none_for_unknown_repository (asserts an unregistered repo id, None, and empty string all resolve to None -- nothing is invented for unknown repositories).

scripts/test_provision_live_supervisor_config.py: extended test_build_live_config_projects_explicit_repository_source_roots and test_build_live_config_projects_clean_standalone_integration_roots with assertions that the rendered coordination.repositories[*].repo field for both pantheon and execute_plans survives unchanged when the renderer rewrites only local_path/integration_path.
not_changing: .orchestrator/config.example.json already declared repo explicitly for both repositories; no change needed there.

.orchestrator/multi_repo_registry.py: no change. repository_slug()/resolve_repository()/repositories() already resolve execute_plans' slug correctly via DEFAULT_REPOSITORIES; this task only makes the committed config match that resolved value explicitly.

scripts/provision_live_supervisor_config.py: no change. apply_repository_source_roots and apply_repository_integration_roots already do repository_config.setdefault(normalized_id, {}) and only set local_path/integration_path on the existing entry, so they were already repo-field-preserving; the new tests make that behavior an explicit, checked contract instead of an unverified assumption.

review-tag publishing logic, admission, or authorization rules -- untouched. The only behavioral surface this task affects is that the raw committed config now carries the same slug repository_slug() already returned, so any future caller that reads coordination.repositories.execute_plans.repo directly (bypassing the registry merge) also finds it.
composes_with: scripts/ai_status.py review_evidence_file_committed / cross-repository review-evidence checks, which call repository_slug() and were already unaffected by this gap in practice but are now defended against a raw-config read or a DEFAULT_REPOSITORIES regression.

The live supervisor config rendered by scripts/provision_live_supervisor_config.py, which mirrors the committed config.json's coordination.repositories.execute_plans.repo through unchanged on the next promotion; no live/runtime config edit is made by this task.

repository_slug_before_after.note: unchanged by this task; already explicit.
repository_slug() call result is unchanged (it always resolved via DEFAULT_REPOSITORIES); the raw committed config field is now explicit.
unregistered repository ids resolve to None both before and after; nothing is invented for unknown repositories.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: Reproduce first: repository_slug returns None for execute_plans because coordination.repositories.execute_plans declares only local_path.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: See diagnosis.reproduce_first above. The precise reproducible fact is that the raw committed dict entry lacks a repo key; repository_slug() itself already resolved 'ajoe734/execute-plans' through the DEFAULT_REPOSITORIES fallback in .orchestrator/multi_repo_registry.py (present since commit d69ba996f, 2026-05-14). This distinction is recorded explicitly rather than overclaiming that repository_slug() was broken.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: Declare the GitHub slug for execute_plans in the committed orchestrator config so repository_slug resolves it; the live config renderer must pass the repo field through unchanged.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: coordination.repositories.execute_plans.repo = "ajoe734/execute-plans" added to .orchestrator/config.json. test_build_live_config_projects_explicit_repository_source_roots and test_build_live_config_projects_clean_standalone_integration_roots in scripts/test_provision_live_supervisor_config.py now assert repositories['pantheon']['repo'] and repositories['execute_plans']['repo'] survive build_live_config() unchanged when apply_repository_source_roots/apply_repository_integration_roots rewrite local_path/integration_path.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: Prove with isolated tests that repository_slug resolves both repositories from the committed config and that an entry without repo still resolves to None for unknown repositories.
